text:
alex_s: Heads up team — Aventis Health POC is moving fast. They want to send a PO but it will be split across two legal entities (Aventis North America, Aventis EU). Need guidance on signer mapping and whether we can accept a single order form with entity appendices or if we need two separate orderforms. Also they flagged KMS in the DPA. @maria_legal @jamal_finance can you advise?

maria_legal: Thanks Alex. Quick q: do they need wet-ink for the EU entity or e-sign will do? That determines countersign flow and whether we need an addendum for EU invoicing.

procurement_contact: procurement_contact from Aventis here — e-sign is fine for both entities, but EU legal requires local entity name + VAT on the invoice. PO will reference our MSA but they asked for a DPA with KMS language.

jamal_finance: Noted. We need the exact invoice entities + tax IDs before we issue invoices. If it's split billing,Finance prefers two POs and two invoices. One orderform with appendix could work, but it complicates tax handling.

sophie_ae: To add, the PO number is `PO-AV-98765`. Customer asked if we can pre-authorize capacity for POC (prepay) or do net30. They're pushing for net30 on POC.

maria_legal: On DPA/KMS: Aventis wants explicit key management language allowing their KMS customer-managed keys. We rarely accept BYO-KMS on Hosted plans. Need to know if this is Hosted or Dedicated/Private. @leo_se any notes from the tech call?

leo_se: They said hosted for now. They only asked for an attestation that data-at-rest keys are managed, but their legal rep went specific on KMS controls and HSM attestation. We can offer token scoping and workspace-level isolation, but BYO-KMS on hosted is an escalator to Private.

jamal_finance: If BYO-KMS pushes to Private, pricing/commit change. We should confirm with customer. Finance hold on Net30 approval until cust credit checks and entity mapping done.

alex_s: Customer reply: they can accept Dedicated if needed but want fast timeline. They asked if we can sign a DPA with an additional KMS appendix for the POC only.

maria_legal: Proposed path: 1) Ask customer to provide VAT/tax IDs and indicate billing entity per PO. 2) For signature: we can do a single MSA + two orderforms referencing entity appendices (cleaner). 3) For KMS: we can offer a POC-specific appendix that documents controls and an HSM attestation, but BYO-KMS requires Private — need SOC2/HSM proof from our side. I'll draft an appendix template and ping SOC/compliance. :pray:

leo_se: I'll pull the security questionnaire item references for KMS and HSM and attach recommended attestation wording.

security_bot: incident-bot: SOC2 report available link: https://redwood.internal/reports/soc2-2025.pdf (access request required).

procurement_contact: Ok we'll provide VAT IDs and can split into two POs if needed. Can you share ETA on the KMS appendix? We need to close this week.

maria_legal: I'll draft the appendix today and send for internal review. If customer agrees to two POs, Finance can proceed faster.

jamal_finance: Action items for Finance: wait for VAT IDs, then trigger credit check and invoice setup. If two POs, mark them as linked to the same MSA.

alex_s: Thanks all — tagging next steps: @procurement_contact please share VAT/tax IDs and confirm single vs two POs; @maria_legal will share draft appendix; @leo_se will post KMS wording. I'll coordinate closure with customer. :thumbsup:

maria_legal: Also quick note: include a clause for POC termination and return/destruction of data. Aventis is strict. I'll add that to the appendix.

procurement_contact: confirmed — will send VAT IDs and prefer two POs. Sending email in 10.

alex_s: great, leaving thread open until docs are in. Thanks everyone!
